title: Act: Switch config.ts to 480x270 and guard computeZoom against invalid dpr
summary: Change render constants and normalise dpr
description: Edit GAME_WIDTH/GAME_HEIGHT and make computeZoom safe for invalid dpr.
acceptance_criteria: computeZoom returns an integer >= 1 for NaN, 0 and negative dpr.
technical_constraints: One native scene resolution of 480x270, whole-number scaling, nearest-neighbour.

steps.action: Change the values from 640 and 360 to 480 and 270.
steps.code:
export const GAME_WIDTH = 480;
export const GAME_HEIGHT = 270;

steps.action: Add const ratio = Number.isFinite(dpr) && dpr > 0 ? dpr : 1 and use ratio instead of dpr in the formula.
steps.code:
const ratio = Number.isFinite(dpr) && dpr > 0 ? dpr : 1;
return Math.max(1, Math.floor(Math.min((w * ratio) / GAME_WIDTH, (h * ratio) / GAME_HEIGHT)));
